name: exp-012-blend-3
description: The repaired standing blend: four general members equally weighted plus exp-010's NM-tail head as a specialist inside nm_late. The winter member is the bounded ds_deice_hr arm, replacing the 25-column day-state block that extrapolated on disrupted days.

blend.why: The desk's rule for four general members is flat unless a fitted vector beats flat in EVERY rotation; it does not (NNLS wins only december, by 0.001). N1-nmtail then earns 0.297-0.336 inside nm_late across the three rotations and exactly 0.000 in nm_bulk, so it is carried as a regime specialist. As a fifth general member it is worth -0.492 s. With the repaired winter member the specialist's share inside nm_late rises from 0.3299 to 0.3522 and the winter member's falls from 0.2401 to 0.1454.

members.name: T-tailv2
members.budget: prc.tail_model declares n_estimators 500 (main) / 300 (noac head); no early stopping, so the multi-month budget rule does not apply - what this member needs instead is a scan to justify the constants.
members.notes: noac head pinned to v2 by NOAC_PIN in the producer. The OOF is exp-009's versioned v2 file, byte-identical to what these weights were fitted on.

members.name: C2-cat
members.budget: 5325 rounds from a single early-stop month (2025-11), rescaled by 12/11 to 5809. NOT compliant with the multi-month budget rule; bringing it into compliance costs about 1.3 GPU-hours.
members.notes: The only GPU member. GPU 1 per docs/COMPUTE.md compute allocation, which counts 2 feeding CPU threads against this lane's cap. Release thread count is 6 per the desk; the 2 used in the first e2e rebuild is what produced the mismatch that destroyed 48acb7e7.

members.name: L2-hub
members.budget: 2100 rounds from a single early-stop month (2025-11), rescaled by 12/11 to 2291. Not compliant by method but VALIDATED by measurement: the patience-900 alternative of 8725 rounds scores 314.41 on july_loo against this arm's 310.84, so the count is right even though the instrument that drew it is the disfavoured one.

members.name: D1-winter
members.budget: 125 rounds, drawn under the multi-month rule and the FIRST member to hit its wide-spread branch: per-month optima 2025-07 107, 2025-01 148, 2025-11 223, median 148, relative spread 0.784 which is above the 0.5 threshold, so the minimum applies rather than the median. The block arm's scan on the same months was [109, 129, 142] at spread 0.256.
members.nondeterminism: linear_tree=True, which LightGBM's deterministic=True does not cover across thread counts. Measured: the same seed at the same thread count drew 148 rounds on one run and 186 on another and scored 307.45 against 311.30 on july_loo, against a seed-to-seed spread of 3.7 s on the same fold. The blend is insensitive to it - a 0.77 s change in this member moves the board estimate 0.014 s.
members.notes: PUBLISHED to exp-016 with a pinned hash (published/MEMBER-D1-winter-deice-v1.md). A rebuild is expected to differ and the pipeline restores the published file rather than clobbering it. Serves 125 rounds while the OOF drew 142/176/221 per fold; the same mismatch on the previous winter member measured 0.014 s.

members.name: N1-nmtail
members.budget: prc.nmtail declares n_estimators 900 with no early stopping, so the multi-month budget rule does not apply; what it needs instead is a scan to justify the constant.
members.notes: Predicts NM-joined departures only; y_pred is null on 5,290 non-NM ranking rows. prc.blend VERSION 5 permits that ONLY because this member's weight outside nm_late is exactly 0.000, and verifies it rather than trusting it.

reproducibility.definition: Bytes reproduce at the DECLARED configuration below: per-member thread count, device, seeds, round count, and the library versions the manifest records. A different thread count gives a different file with the same score to within the recorded spread; see docs/REPRODUCE.md section 4 for the two gates.
reproducibility.release_threads_why: 6 is this lane's compute allocation and therefore the only count we can verify twice. The originals were fitted at 16 and those conditions are unrecoverable.

evidence.L2-hub: 16 -> 6 did not (8da562fc -> 29adfc27); plain trees on CPU, so not a GPU effect

reproducibility.gate_2_score: Rebuild and compare fold RMSE rather than SHA when bytes differ. This is the gate that matters for the result: organisers reproduce the finding, not the file.

hash_semantics: `sha_as_built` records the hash of a SPECIFIC past build, with the date and thread count that produced it. It is a record, not a promise about the next build: this field was revised three times on 2026-09-05/06 and each revision felt like bookkeeping when it was actually re-asserting a claim about the future. The build compares against it explicitly and reports; it does not assume. Framing adopted from exp-016, who reached it first.
